caveat: Published 24 March 2026, outside the window. A scoping review, so the effect claims belong to the primary studies and the 'AI-specific' definitions of critical thinking are the authors' reading of them.
title: Towards a framework for understanding and assessing critical thinking in generative AI-enhanced learning environments: a scoping review
venue: European Journal of Psychology of Education
why: Twenty-nine empirical studies on how critical thinking is being redefined around generative AI, with verification, justification and self-regulated use as the design levers. This is the literature your Professional Criticality papers argue with.
